title: POTV Planet Glass Bubbler
description:
The POTV Planet Bubbler

Enter our hazy orbit with the POTV Planet Glass Bubbler! Vape your way with either a mini whip attachment for hookah-style sessions or direct-draw hits with a removable glass mouthpiece. With our Perfect Blend perc, each inhale is met with unparalleled smoothness and rich, full-bodied flavor.

A bubbler isn’t just an accessory; it’s a game-changer for those who seek smoother, more flavorful sessions. Connect your compatible dry herb vaporizer and enjoy the strongest hits with a gentle touch.

Why POTV Glass?

Enter the fun and effective world of glass with POTV bubblers. Designed with care and expert insight, each piece in our catalog is tested and approved by our team of vape experts to meet our strict standards. We work directly with glassmakers to offer the best price on glass pieces that complement your vape setup.

Choose POTV for a bubbler that matches your style perfectly. With multiple designs tailored for different vape styles, our premium glass pieces are made to be fun AND effective additions to your sessions.

Global shape with our Perfect Blend

This fun, spherical glass bubbler has plenty of volume for water and comes with a wide, stable base and our Perfect Blend percolator. This design strikes the perfect balance of cooling power without stripping away herbal flavors.

Glass mouthpiece or whip!

Take traditional bubbler hits through a detachable glass mouthpiece, or hook up the whip for hookah-style sessions! Our Planet Bubbler comes with a 14mm glass mouthpiece, a 16-inch silicone whip with a glass stem, and a 14mm elbow adapter.

10mm and 14mm connections

The Planet Glass Bubbler comes with a 10mm and a 14mm connection. Connect any compatible adapter to our POTV Planet Bubbler, including our POTV Water Pipe Adapter.

Vaporizers that are compatible with our POTV Water Pipe Adapter:

POTV Lobo
POTV ONE
POTV XMAX V3 Pro
XMAX V3 Pro + POTV Adapter
PAX Plus, PAX Mini, PAX 2, PAX 3 + POTV PAX Adapter.
Mighty+ + Mighty+ Glass Adapter.
Crafty+ + Crafty+ Glass Adapter.
Volcano Hybrid, Volcano Classic + Volcano Glass Adapter

High-quality glass

Our POTV Glass Bubblers are constructed from high-quality borosilicate glass for the purest, cleanest hits.

Return policy

We only accept returns for accessories if they are within 30 days, unused and unopened, or if they are being returned with a vaporizer under our 14-day satisfaction policy.
